package com.datalogger.framework;

/**
 * Defines the contract for all data logging modules within the plugin.
 */
public interface Loggable {
	/**
	 * The unique identifier for this logger (e.g., "grand-exchange").
	 * Used for directory naming and configuration checks.
	 */
	LogType getLogType();

	/**
	 * The CSV header string that defines the columns for this logger's data.
	 * This is written to the file if it's newly created.
	 */
	String getCsvHeader();

	/**
	 * Logic to determine if this specific logger is enabled based on user config.
	 */
	boolean isEnabled();

	/**
	 * Optional: Initialization logic run when the player logs in or the plugin starts.
	 */
	default void setup() {}
}

package com.datalogger.models.enums;

import lombok.Getter;

@Getter
public enum AttackType
{
	MELEE_STAB(CombatType.MELEE),
	MELEE_SLASH(CombatType.MELEE),
	MELEE_CRUSH(CombatType.MELEE),

	RANGED_TYPELESS(CombatType.RANGED),
	RANGED_LIGHT(CombatType.RANGED),
	RANGED_NORMAL(CombatType.RANGED),
	RANGED_HEAVY(CombatType.RANGED),

	MAGIC_TYPELESS(CombatType.MAGIC),
	MAGIC_AIR(CombatType.MAGIC),
	MAGIC_WATER(CombatType.MAGIC),
	MAGIC_EARTH(CombatType.MAGIC),
	MAGIC_FIRE(CombatType.MAGIC),

	TYPELESS(CombatType.TYPELESS),
	NO_COMBAT(null);

	private final CombatType combatType;

	AttackType(CombatType combatType)
	{
		this.combatType = combatType;
	}
}

	private final int objectId;
	private final boolean isFlexibleItemSet;
	private final int[] fallbackItemIds;

	StashUnitData(int objectId, boolean isFlexibleItemSet, int[] fallbackItemIds)
	{
		this.objectId = objectId;
		this.isFlexibleItemSet = isFlexibleItemSet;
		this.fallbackItemIds = fallbackItemIds;
	}

	private static final Map<Integer, StashUnitData> lookupMap = new HashMap<>();

	static
	{
		for (StashUnitData unit : values())
		{
			lookupMap.put(unit.getObjectId(), unit);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Retrieves the STASH unit data based on the physical game Object ID.
	 */
	public static StashUnitData getByObjectId(int objectId)
	{
		return lookupMap.get(objectId);
	}
